narrative.pillar2_desc: From fabric selection to details, every decision creates meaning.

lookbook.hero_desc: Effortless elegance, made practical. Meet Sevilla, a thoughtfully designed abaya that combines timeless style with details that make everyday life easier. Made from a blend of 60% cupro and 40% viscose, the fabric feels soft and smooth, with a beautiful drape that moves naturally with you.
lookbook.purpose_desc1: A beautiful abstract button detail lets you style your abaya in two different ways, giving you more versatility in one piece.
lookbook.purpose_desc2: Designed for extra convenience, making everyday activities and mealtimes easier.
lookbook.purpose_desc3: Functional pockets on both the right and left sides, perfect for keeping your essentials close at hand.
lookbook.practical_desc: Thoughtfully designed to make daily activities—including eating and enjoying a bowl of soup—feel more comfortable and effortless. Sevilla has a timeless silhouette: an elegant, flowing shape that balances comfort, simplicity, and modern femininity.

conscious.mission_desc: Every thread is chosen with deep respect for the Earth, our craftspeople, and the quiet dignity of modest fashion.
conscious.hero_p: SEVAYA was born from a love for timeless design, the beauty of modest dressing, and the belief that what we wear can be both beautiful and meaningful. Inspired by the architectural heritage of Andalusia, particularly the enduring beauty of Sevilla and Granada, SEVAYA brings together understated elegance, thoughtful details, and a sense of quiet simplicity.
conscious.philo_1: We believe modesty is not about making yourself smaller. It is about dressing in a way that feels true to your values while making space for everything you aspire to be. Whether you are leading a team, creating something new, building a career, spending time with loved ones, or simply finding your own rhythm in everyday life, what you wear should support you through it all.
conscious.philo_2: At SEVAYA, we design with this in mind: graceful silhouettes, thoughtful details, and comfort that allows you to move freely through your day. Pieces that respect your commitment to modesty without asking you to compromise on personal style, comfort, or ambition.
conscious.philo_quote: Because being a modest woman does not mean choosing between your faith and your aspirations. You can honour both, beautifully.
conscious.inspo_title: Inspired by Andalusia. Made for the Woman You Are Becoming.
conscious.inspo_p1: There is something timeless about Andalusia. The warmth of its architecture, the rhythm of its courtyards, the intricate patterns of its tiles, and the quiet beauty found in the simplest details.
conscious.inspo_p2: Inspired by Sevilla and Granada, our aesthetic draws from warm Mediterranean tones, graceful forms, and a deep appreciation for thoughtful design. With a background in architecture, we see clothing much like the spaces we inhabit: every proportion, detail, and material has a purpose.
conscious.inspo_p3: We translate this inspiration into modestwear for contemporary women, pieces that feel timeless yet relevant, elegant yet effortless, and beautiful without sacrificing the ease of everyday life.
conscious.inspo_tagline: Rooted in heritage. Designed for the life ahead.
conscious.founder_title: A Personal Journey, Woven into Every Piece.
conscious.founder_p1: My years living in Spain shaped the way I see design. I learned to appreciate not only the beauty of architecture, but also the culture, rituals, and everyday experiences that give meaning to the things we create. With a background in architecture and design, I have always believed that good design should be thoughtful, purposeful, and made to serve the people who experience it.
conscious.founder_p2: SEVAYA grew from that belief, alongside my own personal journey toward dressing more intentionally and deepening my understanding of modesty. I wanted to create clothing that reflected my love for design while supporting the woman I aspire to become: a woman who can pursue her ambitions, embrace her individuality, and remain grounded in her faith.
conscious.founder_p3: SEVAYA is still growing, learning, and discovering better ways to create. We are committed to making more thoughtful choices in our materials, our production, and the way we approach fashion. Every piece is part of that ongoing journey.
conscious.founder_closing: Thank you for being here, and for growing with us.
